disputes.reason: Too general: protection sellers on CDO equity tranches gain when default correlation rises (equity is long correlation), so 'lose when correlation rises' in the explanation is not universally true; card only makes sense with the AIG/senior-exposure context.

Ambiguous: cumulative default probability is higher over a longer horizon for every bond including junk; only the conditional/marginal default probability is front-loaded. A candidate could reasonably judge it true.
